core_concept.definition: The Struggling Avatar (SA) is an identity you create within your messaging ecosystem that your audience self-identifies with and starts using as a label for themselves.
core_concept.example: The author's SA is the 'unheard entrepreneur'; people in the ecosystem start calling themselves that.
mechanism: Messaging is specific enough that the audience's subconscious recognizes 'that is me' without deliberate thought
The audience identifies as the SA but also realizes they don't want to stay that way
That tension creates desire for a way out, which is where the Future Paced Hero (FPH) and Unique Solution come in

tips.tip: Description matters more than the name
tips.detail: Names can be changed any time; the audience doesn't know the SA/FPH framework exists.
Pair a problem-describing word with a softer, positive word.
The author prefers naming people as they are or feel; an accurate description isn't inherently negative. The goal is recognition plus a wish to leave the identity.

steps.title: Your avatar isn't who you think it is
steps.guidance: If you've been through the transformation you now teach, you ARE your avatar — speak to an older version of yourself rather than inventing one.
benefits: Very specific messaging, since you know the avatar's thoughts, feelings, mistakes, actions and beliefs
Lets you weave in your own identities, core values and beliefs
Attracts people most like you at the core who struggle with what you solved

exception.case: You have expertise without personal experience (e.g. a doctor treating illnesses they never had)
exception.approach: Picture your favorite client, interview them for specifics — but still use your own identities and core values in messaging.

steps.title: List struggles and emotions before the transformation
steps.guidance: Yours, or your favorite client's. Multiple are fine.

steps.title: Identify the label or identity of the older you (or client)
steps.guidance: What they felt they were or did — usually a noun.

steps.title: Combine steps 2 and 3 into one identity — your Struggling Avatar
steps.usage: Whenever you describe a mistake, problem, myth or consequence, call the audience by this SA name so they adopt it and want to move out of it.
steps.note: Start with something; it can be changed later.

steps.title: Choose core values and identities to bring into the business
steps.guidance: Mainly for your own awareness, to infuse titles, copy, scripts and everyday social posts; they can also appear in the SA name.
action_items: Pick your top 5 core values from the values list
steps.warning: These will shape who you attract.

steps.title: Build the Struggling Avatar Profile
steps.guidance: A one-page reference you keep filling in through later videos — your north star for relating to the audience, attracting people most like you and not bending to external pressure.

key_takeaways: The SA is a self-adopted identity that sparks recognition and a desire to change.
Usually your avatar is your past self; otherwise, model your favorite client.
Use the SA name consistently whenever discussing problems or mistakes.
Bake your top 5 values and top 3 identities into your messaging.
Keep an evolving SA profile as your messaging north star.
